title: Installment Charges Counted Toward a TRICARE Select Past-Due Balance Cleared by Card
content:
**Clause.** For a one-time card payment clearing the past-due balance of a fee-bearing **TRICARE Select** enrollment, the charges that count toward the past-due balance depend on the enrollment's standing: where the enrollment has ended, the charges whose coverage period began in or before the month containing its last day of coverage count, and a charge for a later period is void; where the enrollment is active, the charges whose coverage period has begun count and a charge billed ahead is left for its due date; otherwise, while the enrollment is awaiting activation, only its first installment, due with the application, counts. The earlier counted charges are the charges that count other than those of the latest installment.

An enrollment's standing is its lifecycle status: it has ended when its status is disenrolled voluntarily, disenrolled for nonpayment, terminated as ineligible or transferred out, whatever the payment date, and its last day of coverage is then the disenrollment date on its record; it is active when its status is active; and it is awaiting activation when its status is applied. A rejected enrollment owes no fee and is outside these rules. A coverage period has begun when it starts on or before the payment date; the fee account is read back over 600 months, which takes in every charge of the enrollment.

## By standing of the enrollment

| Standing | Charges that count | Earlier counted charges |
|---|---|---|
| ended (status disenrolled, terminated as ineligible or transferred out) | those whose coverage period began in or before the month of the last day of coverage; a charge for a later period is void | those charges other than the latest installment's |
| active | those whose coverage period has begun; a charge billed ahead is left for its due date | those charges other than the latest installment's |
| awaiting activation (status applied) | the first installment, due with the application | the first installment, or nothing where it is itself the latest installment |

## Hypothetical illustrations (quarterly installments, latest installment the July quarter)

- Active enrollment, payment on 2026-08-05, charges for the quarters starting 2026-04-01, 2026-07-01 and 2026-10-01: the April and July charges count; the October charge is billed ahead; the earlier counted charge is the April one.
- Enrollment disenrolled voluntarily with a disenrollment date of 2026-08-14, the same charges: the enrollment has ended; the April and July charges count, the October charge is void, and the earlier counted charge is the April one.
- An enrollment transferred out with a disenrollment date of 2026-09-20 has ended even for a payment made on 2026-09-10; its last day of coverage is 2026-09-20.
- A rejected enrollment owes no fee; these rules do not apply to it.
- Enrollment awaiting activation whose first installment is the July quarter's charge: the first installment counts, but as the latest installment it is not an earlier counted charge, so there is none.
